title: 第10章 甲一金城陆第11章 跟你哥真像
slug: 镇守仙秦地牢吞妖六十年
content_zh:
武道九重境，一步一登天。
隐元，洞明，瑶光，开阳。
开阳境是武道第四重境，有此境者，可镇一郡之地。
“金将军……”
张远低语。
金城陆，庐阳府金家天才武者，庐阳城第一位以军功荣归的五品武将。
庐阳城中少年谁不曾以金城陆为榜样，凭手中刀，挣一份荣族耀己的功业？
只是这榜样形象在十年前轰然崩塌。
金城陆率八千战兵出征北域，兵败荒原，麾下皆死于异族之手，唯有他自身脱逃。
据说他是以自己麾下兵卒的性命铺路才活着回来。
仙秦尚武，尚勇。
逃命而回的金城陆成了庐阳城唾弃的笑话。
金家也将他从族谱中除名。
金城陆该是因战败之罪押送皇城问斩，没想到会被关押在庐阳城镇抚司司狱十年。
张远默默的多拿一份饭食放在栅栏前。
“你为何会活着回来？”
张远抬头，看向栅栏中端坐的身影。
消瘦身形，胡须头发已经遮盖面容，双目之中透出晶亮。
没有锁链加身，只有双肩之上各有一根深扎的铁环。
张远的话让本伸手去端饭食的身躯顿住。

“我为何会活着回来，我为何会活着回来……”
喃喃低语，那伸出的手掌将饭食端在手中。
哆嗦着抓饭送入嘴里，声音带着沉闷：“我死了八千兄弟，他们都是为我而死，我怎么能不活？”
“我要活着，我要活着……”
如果还是从前的张远，此时恐怕会直接站起身，指着金城陆的鼻子骂他懦夫。
现在看过胡金仁和孟涛记忆的他，心境已经不同。
胡金仁在第一次杀人时候，曾想过去死，但他最终没死，反而选择去杀更多人，更多无辜的人。
孟涛武力无敌，但他断去一臂，再做不成将军之后，心中信念崩塌，只求速死。
生死之间，靠的是心中的念头。
金城陆这样的人，要说他当真是贪生怕死恐怕说不过去。
这样的人，支撑他活着的信念，是什么？
张远想起了自己的大哥。
父死子承，兄死弟及。
大哥战死，自己没有想过为他报仇，只为他操办后事，然后穿上皂衣。
content_en:
The ninth level of martial arts, reaching the sky one step at a time.
Yin Yuan, Dong Ming, Yao Guang, Kai Yang.
The Kaiyang realm is the fourth level of martial arts. Those with this realm can control an entire county.
"General Jin..."
Zhang Yuan whispered.
Jincheng Lu, a talented warrior of the Jin family in Luyang Prefecture, was the first fifth-grade military general in Luyang City to return with military honors.
Who among the young people in Luyang City has not followed the example of Jincheng Lu and used the sword in his hand to earn a share of his family's glory?
But this role model image collapsed ten years ago.
Jincheng Lu led eight thousand soldiers to the Northern Territory and was defeated in the wilderness. All his men died at the hands of foreigners, but he escaped.
It is said that he came back alive by paving the way with the lives of his soldiers.
Immortal Qin is adept at martial arts and bravery.
Jinchenglu, who escaped for his life, became a despised joke in Luyang City.
The Jin family also removed him from their family tree.
Jincheng Lu was escorted to the Imperial City for questioning due to the crime of defeat, but he did not expect to be imprisoned in Fusi Prison in Luyang Town for ten years.
Zhang Yuan silently took an extra meal and placed it in front of the fence.
"Why did you come back alive?"
Zhang Yuan raised his head and looked at the figure sitting in the fence.
He has a thin figure, his beard and hair have covered his face, and his eyes are shining.
There are no chains attached to the body, only a deep iron ring on each shoulder.
Zhang Yuan's words made the body that was reaching for the food pause.
"Why did I come back alive? Why did I come back alive..."
Whispering, the outstretched palm held the meal in his hand.
Shivering, he put the rice into his mouth and said in a dull voice: "I have eight thousand brothers who died. They all died for me. How can I not live?"
"I want to live, I want to live..."
If he were still the same Zhang Yuan, he would probably stand up right now, point his finger at Jincheng Lu's nose and call him a coward.
Now that he has seen the memories of Hu Jinren and Meng Tao, his mood is different.
When Hu Jinren killed someone for the first time, he wanted to die, but he did not die in the end. Instead, he chose to kill more people, more innocent people.
Meng Tao is invincible in terms of force, but after he lost an arm and could no longer become a general, his faith collapsed and he just wanted to die quickly.
Between life and death, it depends on the thoughts in the heart.
For a person like Jincheng Lu, it would be unreasonable to say that he is really greedy for life and afraid of death.
What is the belief that supports such a person's life?
Zhang Yuan thought of his elder brother.
After the father dies, the son inherits, and after the brother dies, the younger brother inherits.
My eldest brother died in the battle, but I never thought about avenging him. I just arranged the funeral arrangements for him and then put on my soap clothes.
